concept: AWS Config: automatic remediation via SSM Automation
tests: How to automatically remediate non-compliant resources (e.g., re-enable S3 encryption) with minimal code.
expected: AWS Config rules + automatic remediation actions using SSM Automation documents. Triggers: "automatic remediation", "non-compliant", "least custom code".
why_not: CloudTrail and dashboards only observe; manual audits are slow and not automatic.
